CAF.note: The document names the Central African Republic only as a fibre route end-point; it states nothing on state data control there.

facts.fact: The African Development Bank and Congo's backbone project coordinator describe a national data centre under construction in Brazzaville, about 60% of civil works done in May 2024, to host all public data and the national digital ID data in the country rather than abroad.
facts.system: National Data Centre Construction Project in Brazzaville

systems.owner: government of Congo, financed by the African Development Bank
